_comment: Single source of truth for knowledge-gap ledger records. To add or change a key, edit THIS file and commit with op 'schema:'. scripts/gap_ledger.py reads it; nothing else defines gap record keys.

gap.description: A question the wiki could not fully answer, recorded at the moment of the miss.

resolution.description: Intent: this source card is meant to answer that gap. Does not by itself change status.

measurement.description: A re-run of the gap's question against the wiki, recording what came back.

ratification.description: A human judgement that the question is out of scope for this wiki.
